studies.title: Measuring the Earth
studies.caption: Eratosthenes compares the Sun's angle at noon in Alexandria and Syene and works out the Earth's circumference to within a few percent.
studies.prompt: Sunlit courtyard in Alexandria about240BCE, close view of a vertical gnomon casting a short distinct shadow on level ground while an observer uses a cord to measure it. A scroll and measuring tools nearby, distant plain colonnade. One coherent observation, not a labelled diagram or two cities squeezed together.
